info.title: SchachBotManager web API
info.description: Web API of SchachBotManager (backend-api.md, E73): public reading of matches, bots and the game queue; sessions, accounts and administration for invited users (E83, E84, E85); uploading bots and their verification (E91, E92, E93); own bots with their versions and source, and single games set by their owners (E95, E96, E97, E98); disciplines (E100). All times are UTC in RFC 3339; durations are milliseconds. Errors carry a code that the frontend translates (E32). Requests other than GET need the header X-SBM-CSRF: 1 (E84).

get.summary: Liveness of the API and its database connection.

200.description: The API answers and reaches the database.

get.summary: Matches, newest first, without their moves.

parameters.name: bot_id
parameters.description: Only matches in which this bot plays either colour.

post.summary: Puts single games between two verified bots into the queue, at least one of them the account's own (E98). At most 20 games a day per account; they start after the matches of admins.

201.description: The new matches in the order they were queued.

get.summary: One match with all moves played so far.
The match as PGN, also while it runs (result * until it ends).
All verified bots, ordered by name and version.

post.summary: Uploads a bot as source files; the runner then verifies it (E91, E92). The same name as an own bot makes a new version of it, with a higher version number.

201.description: The new bot, waiting for its verification.

get.summary: One bot with the versions of its name. Verified, disabled and retired bots are public; the owner and admins also see the others, and they alone get the details with the verification report (E15, E95).

patch.summary: Changes the description of an own bot, or retires a verified one and makes it verified again (owner, E95, E96). A bot disabled by an admin stays disabled.

get.summary: One file of an uploaded bot as a download (owner and admins, E97). Bots that are not public are not found for others.

parameters.name: path
parameters.description: The path as listed in the details.

200.description: The bytes of the file as uploaded.

Content-Disposition.description: Always attachment, with the file name.

get.summary: All files of an uploaded bot as a ZIP file named Name-Version.zip, in a folder Name-Version (owner and admins, E97).

Content-Disposition.description: Always attachment, with the file name.

get.summary: Running and waiting matches in queue order with estimated start times (E20).
All disciplines ordered by name, the archived ones included (E100).

post.summary: A game of the person against a verified bot, as guest or with the session's account (E11, E114). The answer names the seat to join over the WebSocket at socket_path (gateway-v1); the game itself speaks play-v1. Games against people are not public: they appear in no list (E115).

201.description: The game waits for the person to join.

get.summary: Who is logged in; user is null for guests.

post.summary: Logs in and sets the session cookie.

delete.summary: Ends the session and clears the cookie; also fine without a session.

post.summary: Creates an account from an invite and logs it in (E4, E83).
Sets a new password with a reset link from an admin, ends all other sessions of the account and logs it in.

put.summary: Changes the own password and ends all other sessions of the account.

get.summary: The account's API tokens that are not revoked, newest first (coders, E116).

200.description: The tokens, without the tokens themselves.

post.summary: Makes an API token for remote bots (coders, E116); at most 10 per account. The token is in this answer only.

delete.summary: Revokes an own API token (coders, E116).

post.summary: A game of the token owner's local bot against a verified bot (coders, E116). The local bot joins its seat over the WebSocket at socket_path (gateway-v1) and then speaks the bot protocol v1. Never rated, not public, within the play limits for the address, the account and the token (E115).

201.description: The game waits for the local bot to join.

get.summary: The bots of the logged-in account in every status, newest first.

patch.summary: Changes role or active state of another account (admin); deactivation ends its sessions.

post.summary: A one-time link that sets a new password, valid for 24 hours (admin, E83). An earlier unused link of the account stops working.

201.description: The link; it is shown only this once.

get.summary: Unused invites that have not expired, newest first (admin).

201.description: The invite with its link; the link is shown only this once.

patch.summary: Disables a verified or retired bot, or makes a disabled one verified again (admin, E93, E96); queued matches of a disabled bot are aborted when their turn comes.
Changes or archives a discipline (admin, E100); queued and played matches keep their copy.

post.summary: Puts single games between two verified bots into the queue (admin, E71, E85).

201.description: The new matches in the order they were queued.

get.summary: The limits of interactive games (admin, E115).

put.summary: Sets all limits of interactive games at once (admin, E115); they apply to games asked for from now on.

patch.summary: Pauses or resumes the queue (admin); a running match plays to its end.

200.description: The queue settings now in force.

session.description: The session from POST /session, /invites/redeem or /password-resets/redeem: an HttpOnly cookie for /api/, SameSite=Strict, Secure behind HTTPS; valid until 14 days after its last use (E84).
session.name: sbm_session

token.description: A personal API token from POST /account/tokens as Authorization: Bearer sbm_…; only for remote matches (E116).

Csrf.name: X-SBM-CSRF
Csrf.description: Protection against cross-site requests: browsers send this header from other sites only after a CORS preflight, which the API never allows (E84). Without it the API answers 403 with code csrf_failed.

Forbidden.description: The X-SBM-CSRF header is missing (code csrf_failed) or the account may not do this (code forbidden).

InvalidCredentials.description: Unknown name, wrong password or deactivated account (code invalid_credentials); for routes that need a session also unauthenticated.

TooManyAttempts.description: Too many attempts from this address or for this account; try again later (code too_many_attempts, E84).

Retry-After.description: Seconds until the next attempt may succeed.

BadToken.description: A field is invalid (code invalid_parameter) or the link is unknown, used or expired (code invalid_token).

UsernameTaken.description: The name is in use, also in another case (code username_taken).

BadUpload.description: A field is invalid (code invalid_parameter), or the files break the upload rules (code invalid_upload, with the file to blame in path, if there is one).

NameTaken.description: The name belongs to a bot of another account or to a reference bot (code name_taken), or another upload of the name came first (code upload_conflict).

DisciplineNameTaken.description: Another discipline has the name, also in another case (code name_taken).

TooLarge.description: The request is larger than 3 MiB (code too_large).

PlayLimit.description: The address, account or token already plays a game (code too_many_games), or reached its games for the day (code too_many_attempts, with Retry-After) (E115).

Retry-After.description: Seconds until the daily limit allows the next game; only with too_many_attempts.

NoCapacity.description: Every place for interactive games is taken; try again soon (code no_capacity, E115).

Id.description: Identifier of a document: 24 lowercase hexadecimal digits.

message.description: English text for logs; not shown to users, except as the detail of invalid_upload.

path.description: The file to blame, for invalid_upload.

MatchStatus.description: aborted: discarded after infrastructure errors and not played again (match-runner.md).

Discipline.description: The conditions the match was played under, copied when it was created.

discipline_id.description: The stored discipline the match was queued under; null for free times (E100).

DisciplineName.description: 1 to 40 characters without control characters, unique regardless of case (E100); the API removes leading and trailing spaces.

StoredDiscipline.description: A discipline that matches, and later leagues, are played under (E100). Archived disciplines stay readable, but nothing new may use them.

startup_ms.description: Time for a bot to start and answer init.

tolerance_ms.description: Grace on every move for the transport.

max_moves.description: Full moves until the game is drawn.

DisciplineUpdate.description: At least one field; changes apply to matches queued afterwards.

Side.description: One side of a match. sdk and lang are filled once the bot reported ready.

version.description: Version of the bot; null for matches queued before versions were kept (E95).

MatchFields.description: The fields of MatchSummary, open for extension by Match.

rated.description: Played under a stored discipline from the standard position; only such matches will count for the rating (E100).

clock_ms.description: The mover's remaining time after the move, increment included.

info.description: Search information the bot reported, public (E33).

BotStatus.description: uploaded, analyzing, testing: in the verification; verified: plays; rejected: failed the verification; disabled: stopped by an admin; retired: withdrawn by its owner (verifikation.md, E96).

BotName.description: 3 to 32 letters, digits, _ . or -, starting with a letter or digit; regardless of case the name of one owner's bots (E91).

BotVersion.description: X.Y.Z, each part 0 to 999 without leading zeros (E91).

BotFields.description: The fields of Bot, open for extension by BotDetail.

builtin.description: A reference bot shipped with the SDK (E68, E72).

description.description: Plain text by the owner, at most 500 characters; line breaks but no other control characters (E95).

details.description: Only for the owner and admins; null for everyone else.

versions.description: The versions of the name the viewer may see, this one included, newest first (E95).

kind.description: data: a file for load_data in data/.

owner.description: Name of the owner; null for reference bots.

entry.description: The file the bot starts with; null for reference bots.

sdk_version.description: SDK version of the runtime that verified the bot.

report.description: null until the verification ends, and for reference bots.

VerificationStageName.description: internal: the server could not verify the bot (E92).

Finding.description: A problem the static analysis found (statische-analyse.md).

TestGame.description: One Mindesttest: a game against the reference bot Random (verifikation.md).

truncated.description: Stage analysis: there were more findings than listed.

tests.description: Stage tests, up to the first that failed.

ruleset.description: The rules of the static analysis, e.g. python-1.

runtime.description: Versions in the bots' runtime, e.g. python and sdk.

BotUpload.description: Paths are relative with /; .py files and data files directly in data/, at most 100 of each and 1 MiB each in all (verifikation.md). At most 20 uploads a day per account.

version.description: Higher than every earlier version of the name.

entry.description: The file the bot starts with, in the top folder.

description.description: Plain text by the owner, at most 500 characters; line breaks but no other control characters (E95).

paths.description: The path of each file, in the order of files.

description.description: Plain text by the owner, at most 500 characters; line breaks but no other control characters (E95).

status.description: retired withdraws a verified bot, verified brings it back (E96).

position.description: 1 for the next match to start; 0 for running matches.

estimated_start.description: When the match should start; for running matches when it started.

paused.description: No new matches start while the queue is paused.

waiting.description: In start order; at most 200 entries.

Username.description: 3 to 32 letters, digits, _ . or -, starting with a letter or digit; unique regardless of case (E83).

OneTimeToken.description: The secret part of an invite or reset link, after the # (E83).

Role.description: player: plays against bots with an account (E103); coder: own bots; admin: everything (backend-api.md).

active.description: A deactivated account cannot log in.

UserUpdate.description: At least one field; admins cannot change their own account this way.

url.description: The page of the SPA with the token after the #, so it stays out of server logs.

created_by.description: Name of the admin; null for invites from the command line.

valid_days.description: How long the invite can be used.

url.description: The page of the SPA with the token after the #, so it stays out of server logs.

EnqueueRequest.description: Either discipline_id or free times with initial_time_ms, increment_ms and max_moves (E100). Free times are named after the time control in seconds, e.g. 180+2 or 20+0.5; bots get 10 s to start (E85).

discipline_id.description: A discipline that is not archived; null or missing for free times.

priority.description: Higher starts first; equal priorities in the order queued.

max_moves.description: Full moves until the game is drawn.

start_fen.description: Start position; null or missing for the standard position.

OwnMatchRequest.description: Like EnqueueRequest with tighter limits: from the standard position, at most 10 games, and free times only with the default move limit up to 5 min + 5 s (E98, E100).

discipline_id.description: A discipline that is not archived; null or missing for free times.

PlayRequest.description: A game against a verified bot from the standard position: a discipline in use, or free times up to 30 min + 30 s (E115).

color.description: The person's color; random draws one.

discipline_id.description: A discipline that is not archived; null or missing for free times.

PlaySeat.description: Where to join a new interactive game. The seat is shown only here; it stands for the side in the game (E113).

PlaySettings.description: Limits of interactive games (E115): max_games at once in total; games_per_client at once and games_per_day for each address, account and API token on its own.

name.description: What the token is for, e.g. the machine; 1 to 40 characters.

CreatedApiToken.description: A new token; token appears only here, the server keeps its hash.

RemoteMatchRequest.description: The opponent and a discipline by name as on the website; without a discipline free times up to 30 min + 30 s (E115, E116).

opponent.description: Name of a bot; its newest verified version plays.

discipline.description: Name of a discipline that is not archived; null or missing for free times.
